historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly avoids an undefined probe, but its physical-operation claim is not stated by the Master.

historical_reviews.v3_1: The Wistron rule assigns I2C to BMC/platform-management scope by default; ED-04 permits a project-bound logical plan when board route, target map, operation and oracle are supplied.

original_test_intent: Validate the project-defined management-I2C path for the switch board, including the expected switch-board management devices and their responses, without presuming an unstated cable or continuity procedure.
original_method: After the owner supplies the exact SW_BD revision, BMC/OOB controller and mux route, device/address map, allowed reads and response oracle, collect bounded topology and downstream-health evidence.
manual_activity: The switch-board owner selects the applicable board/revision, maps its management route and downstream devices, approves safe target reads and states separately whether any physical inspection belongs to the project plan.
required_inputs: Expected management targets and downstream-device identities
Reserved reset, power, link-control and thermal exclusions
Expected responses and switch/downstream health criteria
safety_requirements: Do not infer switch-board disconnection or continuity measurement from the item name
Do not scan unknown buses or addresses
Do not read or write reset, power, link-control or side-effect registers
Preserve switch fabric and downstream-device availability
Use verified secret-safe OOB access and do not clear logs
Stop on switch/endpoint disappearance, bus lock, link degradation, BMC loss, thermal or power anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Validate the owner-supplied route and target allowlists
After confirmation, collect only approved switch-board identity/status responses and correlated downstream health
Do not perform physical manipulation, reset, write or broad scan
Keep logical and any later physical evidence separate
engineer_actions: Bind SW_BD identity and management topology
Approve target/register reads and expected responses
Define downstream topology and health acceptance
Provide recovery and decide the result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No executable command exists. Refusing to guess is appropriate, but describing the test as physical continuity is unsupported; the I2C test-set permits a conditional management-path method once the project topology is known.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented BMC/OOB interface to traverse only the approved SW_BD route and read allowlisted identity/status locations while preserving switch and downstream link health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SW_BD, both TBD fields and the two-minute planning estimates are preserved; no bus, address, register, connector or instrument is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SWITCH_BOARD I2C PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint board/switch firmware, capture baseline switch and downstream topology, read only the documented management targets through the approved mux route, compare complete responses with the project oracle, then verify links, endpoints, BMC events and thermal/power state remain unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Creates a project-bound logical evidence plan while keeping the Master placeholders and any physical work unresolved.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Management responses cover logical SW_BD connectivity; they do not prove connector seating, signal integrity or electrical continuity unless separately specified.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mux selection or a side-effect register can reset the switch, remove downstream endpoints or interrupt accelerator/storage traffic.

project_override_considerations: The project may define logical reachability, a physical stage, or both. Each stage needs distinct acceptance and evidence; neither old-review photos nor a logical read can be silently substituted for the other.
expected_evidence: Exact SW_BD source and project applicability
Complete raw identities and status responses
Before/after switch links, endpoint inventory, BMC events and thermal/power health
Separate physical evidence if explicitly required

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: TBD procedure and criteria are incomplete but not mutually contradictory. The physical-continuity narrative exists only in derived reviews.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source identifies a switch-board target within the I2C protocol set, and a deterministic BMC/OOB identity/status plan can be defined after project topology and response inputs are bound. Those are readiness gaps under ED-04.

review_improvement: Removes the unsupported manual-only assumption and makes switch/downstream topology preservation the case-specific proof and safety boundary for conditional management-I2C automation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A switch board can remain physically intact while its management route, mux selection or attached-device topology is wrong, so photographs alone cannot establish the I2C objective. Conversely, the Master never directs a cable action. The appropriate capability is therefore an owner-bound logical route and response check with switch-fabric safeguards, not a fabricated continuity procedure or permanent block.
